title_zh: 为成人读书会选择暴力描写较少的悬疑小说

scenario.label_zh: 为成人读书会选择暴力描写较少的悬疑小说
scenario.goal_zh: 比较两本虚构小说的暴力内容，并选定绑架发生在场外且不描写伤害的一本

context_zh: 成人读书会组织者比较两本原创虚构悬疑小说的内容简介，不涉及真实犯罪。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: We're choosing between The Empty Platform and Last Witness. Have you read the content notes?

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Yes. In The Empty Platform, criminals kidnap a witness, but it happens off the page and no injuries are described.

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: It opens with a lethal attack described in detail. The rest of the plot keeps returning to it.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Our members asked for a lesser degree of violence this month, not another graphic opening.

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Then The Empty Platform seems the better fit. We should still mention the kidnapping in our introduction.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Let's choose that one and include the content note when we announce it.
